title: Conversations 2: Useful words and expressions
about: Small words that help in a conversation: actually, really, else, around, anyway. Short expressions to suggest something, agree and react to news: Let's …, How about …?, I don't mind, Oh dear!, Well done!

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Actually — хибний друг: це «насправді», а не «зараз» і не «актуально». «Зараз» — now. Після Let's і Why don't we — просте дієслово (go), а після How about і What about — дієслово з -ing (going) або іменник. Agree і matter — дієслова, тому I agree, I don't agree, it doesn't matter — без am та is.

rows: Why don't we go to the cinema?
Why don't we going to the cinema?
How about going for a walk?
How about go for a walk?

items.pattern: actually + adjective / verb · Actually, …
items.meaning: what is really true (often not what people think)
items.example: Everyone thinks Tom is shy, but he's **actually** very funny.
more: This cake looks hard to make, but it's **actually** quite easy.
'Are you from Spain?' '**Actually**, I'm from Italy.'
items.watchOut: Хибний друг: actually — «насправді», а не «зараз» і не «актуально». «Зараз» — now: I'm at home now.

items.pattern: really + adjective · really + verb
items.meaning: very; very much
items.example: This film is **really** funny.
more: My grandma makes **really** good pancakes.
I **really** like your new bike.
items.watchOut: Перед прикметником really = very: really cold = very cold. Але перед дієсловом кажуть really, а не very: I really like it (не I very like it).

items.pattern: anything / something / someone / somewhere else · what / who / where else
items.meaning: more, or a different one
items.example: Do you need anything **else** from the shop?
more: This café is full. Let's go somewhere **else**.
Who **else** is coming to your party?
items.watchOut: Else стоїть після слова: something else, who else (не else something). «Ще щось?» — Anything else? «Щось інше» — something else.

items.pattern: around + number / time
items.meaning: about; not exactly
items.example: The bus usually comes at **around** eight o'clock.
more: There are **around** thirty students in my class.
The walk to the lake takes **around** an hour.
items.watchOut: Around тут = about: at around six = at about six. Approximately теж правильно, але в розмові частіше кажуть around або about.

items.pattern: …, anyway (another reason)
items.meaning: used to give one more reason: it is true in any case
items.example: I'll post your letter. I'm going to the post office **anyway**.
more: Don't buy me a ticket. I'm busy on Friday **anyway**.
You can have my old jacket. It's too small for me **anyway**.
items.watchOut: Пишеться одним словом: anyway. Зазвичай стоїть у кінці речення.

items.pattern: Anyway, … (at the start of a sentence)
items.meaning: used to go back to the main thing you were talking about
items.example: I love that film about the dog. **Anyway**, what time does the party start?
more: Sorry, I'm talking about my cat again. **Anyway**, how was your weekend?
**Anyway**, let's talk about your party.
items.watchOut: Тут anyway зазвичай стоїть на початку речення і означає «так от», «ну, загалом»: повертаєшся до головного. Це інше значення, ніж «все одно» в кінці речення.

items.pattern: Why don't we + verb …?
items.meaning: a friendly way to suggest doing something together
items.example: **Why don't we** have a picnic in the park?
more: **Why don't we** ask Grandma to come with us?
It's raining. **Why don't we** watch a film at home?
items.watchOut: Це не питання «чому», а пропозиція. Після Why don't we — дієслово без -ing і без to: Why don't we go (не Why don't we going).

items.pattern: Let's + verb · Let's not + verb
items.meaning: a suggestion: we can do this together
items.example: **Let's** make pancakes for breakfast.
more: It's a sunny day. **Let's** go to the beach!
**Let's** not tell Dad about the surprise.
items.watchOut: Let's = let us. Після нього дієслово без -ing і без to: Let's go (не Let's going, не Let's to go). Не забувай апостроф: Let's.

items.pattern: I don't mind · I don't mind + what / where … · I don't mind + -ing
items.meaning: both or all are OK for me; it's all the same to me
items.uk: мені все одно; я не проти
items.example: 'Pizza or pasta?' '**I don't mind**. Both are good.'
more: **I don't mind** where we sit.
**I don't mind** waiting. Take your time.
items.watchOut: На вибір (це чи те?) найчастіше кажуть I don't mind; It doesn't matter теж можна. Різниця: I don't mind — про тебе («мені все одно»), It doesn't matter — про річ («це не важливо»). Не кажи I don't matter.

items.pattern: It's up to you · It's up to sb
items.meaning: you can decide
items.example: 'Shall we take the bus or walk?' '**It's up to you**.'
more: 'Which game shall we play?' '**It's up to you**. I like them all.'
**It's up to** Mum where we go on holiday.
items.watchOut: Не перекладай слово в слово. Зміст — «тобі вирішувати». Up to you — без for: не It's up for you.

items.pattern: How about / What about + -ing · + noun
items.meaning: used to suggest something
items.example: **How about** going to the zoo on Saturday?
more: 'What shall we have for dinner?' '**What about** soup?'
**What about** inviting Anna to the party?
items.watchOut: Після about — дієслово з -ing: How about going (не How about go). Або іменник: How about a cup of tea?

items.pattern: Oh dear! (+ a question or comment)
items.meaning: said when you are surprised or a bit sad about a small problem
items.example: 'I've lost my bus ticket.' '**Oh dear!** What are you going to do?'
more: **Oh dear!** I've spilt my juice.
'The cat isn't eating.' '**Oh dear!** Is she ill?'
items.watchOut: Dear тут не «дорогий». Oh dear — реакція на маленьку прикрість, як наше «ой» чи «от халепа».

items.pattern: It doesn't matter · It doesn't matter if / who / what …
items.meaning: it's not important
items.uk: нічого страшного; це не має значення
items.example: 'Sorry, I broke your pencil.' '**It doesn't matter**. I've got lots.'
more: **It doesn't matter** if you're a bit late.
**It doesn't matter** who wins. Let's just have fun.
items.watchOut: Matter тут дієслово, тому doesn't: It doesn't matter (не It isn't matter, не It's not matter).

items.pattern: What a pity! · What a pity + sentence
items.meaning: said when you are sad or disappointed about something
items.example: 'The concert is cancelled.' '**What a pity!** I really wanted to go.'
more: **What a pity** you can't stay for dinner!
'There are no tickets left.' '**What a pity!**'
items.watchOut: Обов'язково з a: What a pity! (не What pity!). Те саме значення: What a shame!

items.pattern: Well done! · Well done, + name
items.meaning: said to someone who did something well
items.example: 'I got ten out of ten in my test!' '**Well done!**'
more: **Well done**, everyone! That was a great game.
You tidied your room? **Well done!**
items.watchOut: Не Well made і не Good done. Тільки Well done!

items.pattern: Hurry up! · Hurry up and + verb
items.meaning: be quick! go faster
items.example: **Hurry up!** The film starts in five minutes.
more: **Hurry up** and finish your breakfast. We're late!
Mum always says '**Hurry up!**' in the morning.
items.watchOut: Hurry up — коли просиш когось поспішити. «Я поспішаю» — I'm in a hurry.

items.pattern: Look out! (danger right now)
items.meaning: said quickly when there is danger right now
items.example: **Look out!** There's a ball coming!
more: **Look out!** There's a bike behind you!
**Look out!** That branch is falling!
items.watchOut: Look out! — не «виглянь» (виглянути у вікно — look out of the window). Кажуть, коли небезпека просто зараз.

items.pattern: Be careful! · Be careful with / on sth
items.meaning: take care, something can hurt you or go wrong
items.example: **Be careful!** The soup is very hot.
more: **Be careful** on your bike. The roads are busy.
**Be careful** with Grandma's glasses.
items.watchOut: Be careful — і коли небезпека зараз, і як порада наперед (Be careful in the city). Look out — лише коли небезпека просто зараз.

items.pattern: Absolutely! · Absolutely not!
items.meaning: a strong yes; I agree very much
items.example: 'This is the best pizza in town!' '**Absolutely!**'
more: 'Do you want to come to the park with us?' '**Absolutely!**'
'We should help Mum with dinner.' '**Absolutely!** Let's start now.'
items.watchOut: З -ly: Absolutely! (не Absolute!). Absolutely not! — «Ні в якому разі!»

items.pattern: I agree (with sb) · I don't agree
items.meaning: I think the same / I don't think the same
items.example: 'This book is better than the film.' '**I agree**.'
more: **I don't agree** with you. I think cats are better than dogs.
'We need a bigger table.' '**I agree**. Let's buy one.'
items.watchOut: Agree — дієслово, тому без am: I agree, I don't agree (не I am agree, не I'm not agree). Згоден з кимось — agree with sb.

warmup.explain: Насправді — actually. Це хибний друг: «зараз» — now, а actual — прикметник «справжній».
Після Let's — просте дієслово: Let's go.

warmup.q: How about ___ to the swimming pool?
warmup.explain: Після How about — дієслово з -ing: How about going.
Agree — дієслово: I agree, без am.

warmup.uk: Нічого страшного, у мене є ще одна.
warmup.explain: Нічого страшного — It doesn't matter. Matter — дієслово, тому doesn't.
Вирішуй сам — It's up to you.
Перед дієсловом — really: I really like it. Не I very like.

A.q: We waited for ___ twenty minutes, maybe a bit more.
I'm full, thanks. I don't want anything ___ to eat.
I thought the test was going to be hard, but it was ___ easy.

B.explain: Мені все одно — I don't mind.

B.q: How about ___ a cake for Dad's birthday?
'I've got a cold, so I can't play in the match.' '___! Get better soon.'
B.explain: Ой, халепа — Oh dear! Well done — похвала, Absolutely — сильна згода.

example.title: A cake for Dad
example.uk:
У суботу в тата був день народження. «Може, спечемо йому торт?» — запитала моя сестра. «Гарна ідея! Давай спечемо шоколадний», — сказав я.

Ми почали приблизно о третій. Потім я впустив яйця на підлогу. «Ой, халепа!» — сказав я. «Нічого страшного, — сказала сестра. — У нас є ще».

Торт мав дивний вигляд, але насправді був дуже смачний. Коли тато прийшов додому, він усміхнувся. «Молодці, ви обоє! — сказав він. — А тепер швидше несіть тарілки!»
example.en:
It was Dad's birthday on Saturday. '[[Why don't we|b1]] make him a cake?' my sister asked. 'Good idea! [[Let's|b2]] make a chocolate one,' I said.

We started at [[around|a4]] three o'clock. Then I dropped the eggs on the floor. '[[Oh dear!|b6]]' I said. '[[It doesn't matter|b7]],' said my sister. 'We've got more.'

The cake looked strange, but it was [[actually|a1]] [[really|a2]] good. When Dad came home, he smiled. '[[Well done|b9]], you two!' he said. 'Now [[hurry up|b10]] and get the plates!'
